functionHooks.text: extern void rocket_graphics_camera_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); rocket_graphics_camera_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Apply project-owned FOV, cutscene-preservation, far-clip extension and conservative camera-shake attenuation immediately before Rocket builds the projection/view matrices. Temporary guest camera values are restored as soon as the first object frustum test confirms the graphics task has consumed them, and otherwise on the next camera build.

functionHooks.text: extern void rocket_graphics_frustum_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); extern void rocket_widescreen_frustum_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); rocket_graphics_frustum_begin(rdram, ctx); rocket_widescreen_frustum_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Apply Rocket-R world-detail render-distance policy, then widen only the two horizontal retail frustum planes to the selected output aspect. Both operations happen at frustum_test entry and fail closed for Original 4:3.

functionHooks.text: extern void rocket_presentation_frame_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); rocket_presentation_frame_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Begin Rocket's semantic presentation capture when the newly selected GfxTask becomes the active graphics context. This is before RenderEntry construction and before any later depth sorting can destroy owner order.

Capture each unsorted RenderEntry's nested display list, matrix pair, callsite, lifetime track and world position before Rocket sorts opaque/translucent entries by depth. This is Rocket's equivalent of DKR-R's render_object semantic owner hook.
Freeze the completed frame's semantic matrix sidecar at Rocket's graphics-task submission boundary and bind it to the task display-list root, matching DKR-R's FIFO task-owned identity architecture.
Rocket-R v33: mark the start of the pre-world background/sky display-list command range without modifying the renderer or v32 live RenderEntry queue.
Rocket-R v33: close the background/sky command range immediately before the depth/world pass so RT64 can interpolate only that presentation subtree.
